global_style: Earthy, Morandi-inspired presentation template utilizing organic background shapes framing elevated white content cards.

identity_anchors: Organic, oversized fluid shapes in muted earthy tones serving as a background frame
Central elevated white rectangular canvas with subtle drop shadow for content hosting
Use of twin colored circular dots flanking slide titles as a recurring motif
High-contrast elegant serif typography for large display headings

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
